textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 6 english · A Bottle of Dew · Complete Summary
textbookBox.concept: Rama Natha carried the bottle to the sage. The sage smiled, muttered something over it and gave it back, telling him to try it. Rama Natha sprinkled a few drops on a copper vessel and waited.

beats.en: Let us review the key takeaway from A Bottle of Dew: Rama Natha carried the bottle to the sage. The sage smiled, muttered something over it and gave it back, telling him to try it. Rama Natha sprinkled a few drops on a copper vessel and waited. Nothing happened.
